mod.overview: Shifter v1Y Xtreme (Yukichigai's 09-12-2004 release) merges Shifter_v1Y's weapon/mode customization and server switches with Shifter Xtreme's expanded arsenal, buyable Neo-Juggernaught and WeaponSmith armors, and dozens of extra turrets.
notes: Expands the buyable armor roster to 11 classes by adding HeavyArmor ('Neo-Juggernaught', harmor, 4 weapons) and WeaponSmith (dmarmor, 4 weapons), and raises $MaxWeapons for Goliath (5) and DreadNaught (7).

Adds Shifter Xtreme weapons and packs onto the v1Y base: FusionBlaster, MineLauncher (MinelAmmo), ALaserRifle, HammerGun, HammerGun2, HammerPack, OpticPack ('Cybernetic Laser'), DeployableInv2Pack, and ShockForceFieldPack.

Adds 13 turret deployables: Godhammer Turret (GHPack), Grav Turret (DeployableGrav), Boomstick Turret (BoomPack), Chaos Turret (HyperBPack), Frag/Super Frag/EMP Frag/Ultra Frag Turrets, Tactical Nuke Turret (NukePack), Fusion Turret, Dart Turret (TranqPack), and Flamer Turret (FlamerPack), plus FlagHunter.cs.
